title: Animal Farm
author: George Orwell
description: The animals of Manor Farm overthrow their farmer and run the place themselves, until the pigs start to look a lot like the old master.
reasons: want a short, sharp fable about how revolutions get hijacked
are interested in propaganda and how language gets bent
want a classic you can read in an afternoon
like satire that works even if you skip the history
dislikes: The allegory is so direct that the characters are mostly symbols
It lands harder if you already know the Russian Revolution
